essence: The disciple's journey to the guru spans one to twelve yojanas.
A distant disciple reaches the guru through devoted travel.
A very distant disciple may proceed according to his wish.
The disciple offers fruits, flowers, garments, and similar items as he is able.
The guru, his power, his son, and his elder brother are remembered as guru.
